title: My Class Is Dungeon Master (Part 1)
summary: The king hands a kid a broom for getting the Dungeon Master class. When the prince takes his little brother underground, the kid starts rearranging the dungeon.
frame_0: The kid in an orange shirt and purple cloak reads a rune book at the broken edge of a royal courtyard. The split class stone and castle stand behind him, and nine torchlit galleries descend below.
package_differences: Jake approved the rounded Reflection cast and bright daytime courtyard. The boy wears the original burnt-orange shirt and a purple reading cloak.
Steady shots introduce the class ceremony. A continuous camera move follows the dungeon gags and the floating castle from 25 seconds.
The original narrator and word timings stay on their supplied clock. Recorded court, wood, stone, coin and water sounds accompany the dialogue.
The sponsor edition extends the last scene into the 9.30-second phone demonstration with the approved sponsor voice. The clean film ends on the reader and floating castle.
